checked: Accepts one(8,8) tensor with(8) direction or matching leading batch dimensions(...,8,8)/(...,8); shape mismatches raise KernelError invalid_shape before DD matmul.
Shared _array validates real numeric inputs, converts to float64 and rejects nonfinite inputs with existing error codes. No input array is mutated.
Matrix rows are force components and columns are displacement components. No transpose, symmetry operation, fixed-DOF removal or boundary policy is applied.

dd_from retains each supplied binary64 coefficient, dd_matmul retains product errors and a fixed-order eight-term sum, pair_supported enforces the original arithmetic support and dd_value rounds at the output boundary.
The result has matching(...,8) shape. Units are tensor units times direction units; a dimensionless diagnostic direction gives N/mm, not an applied physical force.
The function consumes an already computed element tensor. It has no constitutive force/tangent evaluation, solver, model construction, reference or JIT call.
range_review_boundary: This reviewer did not execute the consumer or prove recorded-data support. The mathematical review separately handles the supplied K and dyadic witness range proof. For arbitrary inputs the original unsupported_arithmetic_range rejection remains part of the API; finite inputs alone are not a universal support guarantee.
